anyOf.$comment: forbidden Morph top-level metadata; canonical path is metadata.title or encrypted_metadata
forbidden Morph top-level metadata; canonical path is metadata.summary or encrypted_metadata
forbidden encrypted content carrier; canonical name is encrypted_content

id.description: Present on the materialised object. MUST be absent from the create Event payload: zh/models/common-fields.md derives it from the create Event's own event_id (retyped), so a payload-supplied id would be a second, forgeable truth.

scope_circle_id.description: Optional reference to an intra-Realm Circle that defines this Morph's effective scope. Omitted means Realm-default scope. The producer signs the corresponding Event.scope_ref; the receiver verifies scope_circle_id.realm_id == Morph.realm_id and exact equality between the derived scope and Event.scope_ref before materializing the object's immutable effective_scope.

schema_refs.description: Authoritative structural schema set for Morph fields. Reducers MUST validate fields against exactly these refs; morph_kind and facets are not a replacement for schema_refs. Generic before-to-after transition validation is not provided by JSON Schema.

encrypted_metadata.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is a morph_metadata object. Required instead of plaintext metadata when the effective metadata_encryption_floor is e2ee_required.

encrypted_content.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is a ContentBlock for Morph content.

state.description: Morph lifecycle state. 'active' is the default. Reducer enforces transitions per common-fields.md §5.1: ak.morph.archive MUST come from 'active' (else failed_precondition reason=morph_not_active); ak.morph.restore MUST come from 'archived' (else morph_not_archived); ak.redaction targeting the morph MUST come from {'active','archived'} (else morph_already_terminal). Same-state self-transitions MUST fail. 'redacted' is the irreversible terminal.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding ak.morph.archive / ak.morph.restore / redaction Event. Aligns with Space.state_changed_at and the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

stage.description: Optional Morph business-progression stage. Orthogonal to top-level 'state' (physical lifecycle). A morph_kind profile MAY require it; generic mirror/data Morphs may omit it. If absent, the first ak.morph.stage.set initializes the axis to any registered value; later changes follow the normal transition rules. ak.morph.update patches on stage / stage_changed_at MUST be rejected. Stage transitions do not carry a reason/note; explanations belong in a referenced Message. See models/common-fields.md §5.3.

stage_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent stage transition. MUST be ignored when present on wire; reducer overwrites with the triggering ak.morph.stage.set event's created_at. Same-value self-transitions MUST NOT update this field.

allOf.$comment: Mirror of message.schema.json's state=redacted branch: the content slot (content <-> encrypted_content) MUST be absent once redaction has cleared it, so 'redacted' is verifiable from the object alone instead of only from the event stream (zh/models/common-fields.md §5 redacted row, §5.2; zh/models/event-and-patch.md §4.2.4).

morph_metadata.description: Extensible user-readable Morph metadata. Morph business fields stay in the top-level fields object; metadata carries display-oriented fields such as title and summary. In MLS / E2EE realms this object is encrypted as encrypted_metadata unless the Realm explicitly opts into plaintext metadata.

not.$comment: Reducer-owned fields and Morph business fields stay top-level and MUST NOT be mirrored inside metadata.

Reject discriminator field `type`, composite child array name `blocks`, and byte-count field `size`; canonical content blocks use `kind`, composite children use `parts`, and byte counts use `size_bytes`.

body.description: Inline text body. Authoritative bound is 256 KiB UTF-8 bytes enforced by a byte validator; maxLength is a not-wider code-point fast bound. Longer bodies MUST use ak.content.long_text (zh/models/content-types.md section 4.1.4).
